title: WHO eyes 'encouraging' signs in DR Congo fight against Ebola
summary: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo is still spreading but appears to be showing "encouraging" signs of improvement, the head of the World Health Organization said on Wednesday.
